title: Validate E170 source reads through save lifecycle
changes: Add an ignored EUR/Wine integration test for every declared E170 source byte after failed replacement, slot Load, Undo, backup restore and restart using synthetic saves.
validation: Windows GNU test build siostytu and Wine unit i73r4f54 passed: 113 resources, 54792 declared spans and 10948338 distinct source bytes in each of five phases, with backing ROM inverted; range and conditional-word owners served reads, expected states and owner persisted, protected inputs remained unchanged and scratch was removed.
limitations: The test uses direct APIs and a missing replacement path without moving the active dataset; GUI, Fast, guest execution, individual resource attribution, native Windows, Linux and USA remain outside its scope.
